verses.sloka: ततस्तस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे महेन्द्रस्य महाबलाः ।हनुमत्प्रमुखाः प्रीतिं हरयो जग्मुरुत्तमाम् ।। ५.५८.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasya gireḥ śṛṅge mahendrasya mahābalāḥ ।hanumatpramukhāḥ prītiṁ harayo jagmuruttamām ।। 5.58.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the mighty Hanuman and other vanaras having assembled on the summit of mountain Mahendra and felt vey much happy.

verses.sloka: तं ततः प्रीतिसंहृष्टः प्रीतिमन्तं महाकपिम् ।जाम्बवान् कार्यवृत्तान्तमष्टच्छदनिलात्मजम् ।। ५.५८.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ tataḥ prītisaṁhṛṣṭaḥ prītimantaṁ mahākapim ।jāmbavān kāryavṛttāntamaṣṭacchadanilātmajam ।। 5.58.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, very delighted Jambavan inquired Hanuman most affectionately of all that happened.

verses.sloka: कथं दृष्टा त्वया देवी कथं वा तत्र वर्तते ।तस्यां वा स कथंवृत्तः क्रूरकर्मा दशाननः ।। ५.५८.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ dṛṣṭā tvayā devī kathaṁ vā tatra vartate ।tasyāṁ vā sa kathaṁvṛttaḥ krūrakarmā daśānanaḥ ।। 5.58.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "How did you find the godlike lady? How was she? How was the tenheaded one, cruel in action, behaving with her? You may narrate what she said.
translations.hindi: ने प्रसन्न हो ( हनुमानजी की बात का समर्थन करते हुए) कहा वानर लोग वश्य मधुपान करे । क्योंकि हनुमानजी काम पुरा कर श्राए हैं

verses.sloka: तत्त्वतः सर्वमेतन्नः प्रबूहि त्वं महाकपे ।श्रुतार्थाश्चिन्तयिष्यामो भूयः कार्यविनिश्चयम् ।। ५.५८.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tattvataḥ sarvametannaḥ prabūhi tvaṁ mahākape ।śrutārthāścintayiṣyāmo bhūyaḥ kāryaviniścayam ।। 5.58.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman, tell us in detail the entire thing. On hearing it, we will think about the next course of action.
translations.hindi: यदि यह कोई अनुचित काम भी करने को फहें तो भी हम लोगों को उसे करना चाहिये प्रौर उनकी इस कही हुई उचित बात की तो कोई बात ही नहीं है । बड़े-बड़े वानरों ने भ्रङ्गद के मुख से ये वचन सुन

verses.sloka: यश्चार्थस्तत्र वक्तव्यो गतैरस्माभिरात्मवान् ।रक्षितव्यं च यत्तत्र तद्भवान् व्याकरोतु नः ।। ५.५८.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścārthastatra vaktavyo gatairasmābhirātmavān ।rakṣitavyaṁ ca yattatra tadbhavān vyākarotu naḥ ।। 5.58.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are wise and you should tell us in detail what is to be told and what has to be hidden when we report."
translations.hindi: प्रत्यन्त प्रसन्न ,हो प्रौर “वाह-वाह” कह कर, अङ्गद के प्रति सम्मान अदर्श्ित किया । तदनन्तर वानरश्रेष्ठ ग्रङ्गद के प्रति सम्मान प्रदर्शित कर, सब बड़े-बड़े वानर

verses.sloka: स नियुक्तस्ततस्तेन संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः ।प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै प्रत्यभाषत ।। ५.५८.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa niyuktastatastena saṁprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ ।praṇamya śirasā devyai sītāyai pratyabhāṣata ।। 5.58.6 ।।।।

translations.english: Having been asked (by Jambavan and others) Hanuman with horripilations all over his body, bowed down and saluted in the direction of queen Sita and began:
translations.hindi: नदी की वेगवान धार की तरह उस मधुवन में बड़े वेग से घुस गये पौर बलपूर्वक वहाँ के रक्षकों पर श्राक्रमण किया ग्रयवा वनरक्षक्ष वान रा को पकड़ा

verses.sloka: प्रत्यक्षमेव भवतां महेन्द्राग्रात् खमाप्लुतः ।उदधेर्दक्षिणं पारं कांक्षमाणः समाहितः ।। ५.५८.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣameva bhavatāṁ mahendrāgrāt khamāplutaḥ ।udadherdakṣiṇaṁ pāraṁ kāṁkṣamāṇaḥ samāhitaḥ ।। 5.58.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "I rose upwards leaping into the sky, intent on reaching the southern shore from the mountain Mahendra.It has been witnessed directly by all of you.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे भ्रङ्गदजी की भ्राज्ञा पाने, जानकीजी को देखने भौर उनका संदेसा पाने से वे वानर भ्रत्यन्त उद्दण्ड हो मधु पीने लगे ग्रौर रसीले फल खाने खगे

verses.sloka: गच्छतश्च हि मे घोरं विघ्नरूपमिवाभवत् ।काञ्चनं शिखरं दिव्यं पश्यामि सुमनोहरम् ।। ५.५८.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: gacchataśca hi me ghoraṁ vighnarūpamivābhavat ।kāñcanaṁ śikharaṁ divyaṁ paśyāmi sumanoharam ।। 5.58.8।।।।

translations.english: "Even as I was leaping I saw a terrific and wonderful golden peak which came as if to obstruct me on my path.
translations.hindi: जो सेकड़ों वनरक्षक उन्हें प्राकर वरजते, उन्हें वे सब के सब उछल- उछल कर मारते थे

verses.sloka: स्थितं पन्थानमावृत्य मेने विघ्नं च तं नगम् ।। ५.५८.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sthitaṁ panthānamāvṛtya mene vighnaṁ ca taṁ nagam ।। 5.58.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "The mountain stood on my way turning towards me in order to obstruct me. Then I resolved in my mind that this great, wonderful, golden mountain has to be smashed.

verses.sloka: उपसङ्गम्य तं दिव्यं काञ्चनं नगसत्तमम् ।कृता मे मनसा बुद्धिर्भेत्तव्यो ऽयं मयेति च ।। ५.५८.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: upasaṅgamya taṁ divyaṁ kāñcanaṁ nagasattamam ।kṛtā me manasā buddhirbhettavyo 'yaṁ mayeti ca ।। 5.58.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hit by my tail the great mountain peak, which was radiating like the Sun was shattered into a thousand pieces.
translations.hindi: मधु के समान पीले रङ्ग के वे वानर मधु पीते भी थे श्रौर फॅलाते भी थे। कोई तो मदमस्त हो, छत्ते के मोम से दूसरे वानरों को मारते थे

verses.sloka: प्रहतं च मया तस्य लांगूलेन महागिरेः ।शिखरं सूर्यसङ्काशं व्यशीर्यत सहस्रधा ।। ५.५८.११ ।।११७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahataṁ ca mayā tasya lāṁgūlena mahāgireḥ ।śikharaṁ sūryasaṅkāśaṁ vyaśīryata sahasradhā ।। 5.58.11 ।।117 ।।।।

translations.english: "Perceiving that I am going to smash him he spoke to me in a sweet tone delighting my heart, addressing me like a son.
translations.hindi: उनमें से कोई-कोई पेड़ की जड़ों में वृप्तों की शाखाएँ पकड़ कर खड़े हुए थे और कोई-कोई नशे से बेहोश हो पत्तों को बिछा कर सो रहे थे

verses.sloka: व्यवसायं च तं बुद्ध्वा स होवाच महागिरिः ।पुत्रेति मधुरां वाणीं मनः प्रह्लादयन्निव ।। ५.५८.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vyavasāyaṁ ca taṁ buddhvā sa hovāca mahāgiriḥ ।putreti madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ manaḥ prahlādayanniva ।। 5.58.12 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Know me to be a friend of windgod and so I am like your father's brother. I am dwelling in this great ocean and known as Mainaka.

verses.sloka: पितृव्यं चापि मां विद्धि सखायं मातरिश्वनः ।मैनाकमिति विख्यातं निवसन्तं महोदधौ ।। ५.५८.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pitṛvyaṁ cāpi māṁ viddhi sakhāyaṁ mātariśvanaḥ ।mainākamiti vikhyātaṁ nivasantaṁ mahodadhau ।। 5.58.13 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O son in the past, foremost of the mountains too had wings and they used to range at will all over the earth tormenting all.
translations.hindi: कोई-कोई तो प्रसन्न हो सिंहनाद कर रहे थे, कोई-कोई पक्षियों की तरहू कूज रहे थे । श्रनेक वानर मतवाले हो पृथिवी पर पड़े सो रहे थे

verses.sloka: पक्षवन्तः पुरा पुत्र बभूवुः पर्वतोत्तमाः ।छन्दतः पृथिवीं चेरुर्बाधमानाः समन्ततः ।। ५.५८.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pakṣavantaḥ purā putra babhūvuḥ parvatottamāḥ ।chandataḥ pṛthivīṁ cerurbādhamānāḥ samantataḥ ।। 5.58.14 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Mahendra, the killer of ogre Paka, heard the story (of the cruel deeds) of mountains and cut off their wings into a thousand pieces with his thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: कोई-कोई गंवारपन कर हँस रहे थे, कोई-कोई तरह-तरह की चेष्टाएँ कर रहे थे, कोई-कोई कुछ बकते श्रौर कोई-कोई उसका ग्रथे और का प्रौर ही लगा रहे थे

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा नगानां चरितं महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः ।चिच्छेद भगवान् पक्षान् वज्रेणैषां सहस्रशः ।। ५.५८.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā nagānāṁ caritaṁ mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ।ciccheda bhagavān pakṣān vajreṇaiṣāṁ sahasraśaḥ ।। 5.58.15 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O son I was saved from Indra by your kind father Maruta who dropped me in this great ocean.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर दधिमुख के नीचे काम करने वाले जो मधुवनरक्षक थे, बे भी इन भयङ्कर वानरों की मार से भाग गए थे

verses.sloka: अहं तु मोक्षितस्तस्मात्तव पित्रा महात्मना ।मारुतेन तदा वत्स प्रक्षिप्तो ऽस्मि महार्णवे ।। ५.५८.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tu mokṣitastasmāttava pitrā mahātmanā ।mārutena tadā vatsa prakṣipto 'smi mahārṇave ।। 5.58.16 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O subduer of enemiesI must make efforts to help Rama the foremost among the righteous, for I have received help (from your father) who is equal to Indra in valour'.
translations.hindi: श्रनेक रक्षकों को तो घुटनों से रगइ-रगड़ कर इन ।वानरों ने यमालय भेज दिया था। जो भाग कर बच गए थे; उन्होंने जाकर दधिमुख से कहा

verses.sloka: रामस्य च मया साह्ये वर्तितव्यमरिन्दम ।रामो धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः ।। ५.५८.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmasya ca mayā sāhye vartitavyamarindama ।rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ śreṣṭho mahendrasamavikramaḥ ।। 5.58.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "When I heard Mainaka, I told him about my intention to go up. That great self Mainaka allowed me.

verses.sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मैनाकस्य महात्मनः ।कार्यमावेद्य तु गिरेरुद्यतं च मनो मम ।। ५.५८.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā vacastasya mainākasya mahātmanaḥ ।kāryamāvedya tu girerudyataṁ ca mano mama ।। 5.58.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "When I heard Mainaka, I told him about my intention to go up. That great self Mainaka allowed me.
translations.hindi: दधिमुख ने उन वनरक्षक वानरों के वचन सुन और मधुवन को नष्ट हुआ देख, क्रुद्ध हो उन रखवालों को धीरज बघाया

verses.sloka: तेन चाहमनुज्ञातो मैनाकेन महात्मना ।स चाप्यन्तर्हितः शैलो मानुषेण वपुष्मता ।शरीरेण महाशैलः शैलेन च महोदधौ ।। ५.५८.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena cāhamanujñāto mainākena mahātmanā ।sa cāpyantarhitaḥ śailo mānuṣeṇa vapuṣmatā ।śarīreṇa mahāśailaḥ śailena ca mahodadhau ।। 5.58.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the huge mountain in human form concealed as huge mountains remain hidden in the ocean.

verses.sloka: उत्तमं जवमास्थाय शेषं पन्थानमास्थितः ।ततो ऽहं सुचिरं कालं वेगेनाभ्यगमं पथि ।। ५.५८.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uttamaṁ javamāsthāya śeṣaṁ panthānamāsthitaḥ ।tato 'haṁ suciraṁ kālaṁ vegenābhyagamaṁ pathi ।। 5.58.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then with great speed I proceeded on my path. It took a long time to cross the ocean.

verses.sloka: ततः पश्याम्यहं देवीं सुरसां नागमातरम् ।समुद्रमध्ये सा देवी वचनं मामभाषत ।। ५.५८.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paśyāmyahaṁ devīṁ surasāṁ nāgamātaram ।samudramadhye sā devī vacanaṁ māmabhāṣata ।। 5.58.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "I saw Surasa, the mother of serpents in the midst of the ocean and she said:
translations.hindi: उनके बीच में जाते हुए दघिमुख ने एक बड़ा वृक्ष उखाइ और उसे ले जल वातरो पर आक्रमण किया । दधिमुख के साथ उसके साथी वानर भी दौड़

verses.sloka: मम भक्षः प्रदिष्टस्त्वममरैर्हरिसत्तम ।अतस्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि विहितस्त्वं चिरस्य मे ।। ५.५८.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mama bhakṣaḥ pradiṣṭastvamamarairharisattama ।atastvāṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmi vihitastvaṁ cirasya me ।। 5.58.22 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O powerful monkey you are destined to be my food provided by the immortals. Therefore, I will eat you as I have I found you after a long time. (of unsatiated hunger).'
translations.hindi: उनमें से बहुतों ने शिलाग्रों, बहुतों ने वृक्षों प्रौर बहुतों ने बड़े-बड़े पत्बरों को हाथ में ले लिया और क्रोध में भरे हुए वे उन हनुमानादि बातरौं के समीप जा पहुँचे

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तः सुरसया प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतः स्थितः ।विवर्णवदनो भूत्वा वाक्यं चेदमुदीरयम् ।। ५.५८.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ surasayā prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ ।vivarṇavadano bhūtvā vākyaṁ cedamudīrayam ।। 5.58.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "When addressed thus by Surasa, I bowed low with joined palms, stood before her with my face turned pale, and said:
translations.hindi: वे भ्रपने स्वामी दधिमुख की शाज्ञा से उत्साहित हो, बड़ी शीघ्रता से सालवृक्षों, तालवृक्षों तथा शिलारूपी भ्रायुधों को ले बड़े वेग से दौड़े

verses.sloka: रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया च परन्तपः ।। ५.५८.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmān praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā ca parantapaḥ ।। 5.58.24 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Dasaratha's son, the illustrious Rama, a scorcher of enemies, accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and wife Sita entered Dandaka forest.
translations.hindi: हजारों वनरक्षक वीर वानरों ने उन वृक्षों पर चढ़े हुए तथा वृक्षों के नीचे बैठे हुए वानरों पर ध्राक्रमण किया

verses.sloka: तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना ।तस्याः सकाशं दूतो ऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात् ।। ५.५८.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya sītā hṛtā bhāryā rāvaṇena durātmanā ।tasyāḥ sakāśaṁ dūto 'haṁ gamiṣye rāmaśāsanāt ।। 5.58.25 ।।।।

translations.english: 'His wife was abducted by the evilminded Ravana. By Rama's command I am going to meet her as messenger from Rama.'
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे उस पटकी'के/ शत सि झविंधृहि की" बी, ०0 भु में चोट लगी । तब वह लोहूलुहान तथा विकल हो, मुहूर्तं भर मूच्छित पड़ा रहा

verses.sloka: कर्तुमर्हसि रामस्य साहाय्यं विषये सती ।अथवा मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।। ५.५८.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kartumarhasi rāmasya sāhāyyaṁ viṣaye satī ।athavā maithilīṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṁ cākliṣṭakāriṇam ।। 5.58.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "I told her that it is proper for her (living in the domain of Rama) to help his queen and wife. Or else, I promised after I disclose to Rama, Sita's whereabouts, I will come and enter her mouth.
translations.hindi: इतने में दधिमुख ने बड़े जोर से वह वृक्ष फेंका । भ्रपने चाचा के मामा के चलाए हुए उस वृक्ष को, क्रुद्ध भङ्गद ने उछल कर बीच ही में दोनों हाथों से पकड़ लिया

verses.sloka: आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिश्रृणोमि ते ।। ५.५८.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āgamiṣyāmi te vaktraṁ satyaṁ pratiśrṛṇomi te ।। 5.58.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus addressed by me, that Surasa, who could take any form at will, said: None can pass me—this is my boon.
translations.hindi: उस सयय अङ्गद ऐसे मदान्ध हो रहे थे कि उन्होंने भ्रपने चाचा सुग्रीव के मामा का मी कुछ विचार न किया । उन्होंने झट दघिमुख को पकड़ कर, -बड़े जोर से जमीन पर पटक दिया

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता मया सा तु सुरसा कामरूपिणी ।अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम ।। ५.५८.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā mayā sā tu surasā kāmarūpiṇī ।abravīnnātivarteta kaścideṣa varo mama ।। 5.58.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Surasa said this I who was ten yojanas in height increased by fifteen yojanas.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तः सुरसया दशयोजनमायतः ।ततो ऽर्धगुणविस्तारो बभूवाहं क्षणेन तु ।मत्प्रमाणानुरूपं च व्यादितं तु मुखं तया ।। ५.५८.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ surasayā daśayojanamāyataḥ ।tato 'rdhaguṇavistāro babhūvāhaṁ kṣaṇena tu ।matpramāṇānurūpaṁ ca vyāditaṁ tu mukhaṁ tayā ।। 5.58.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "She too opened her mouth wide enough for my size. Seeing her distending her mouth, in a moment I became small equal to the size of thumb and came out.

verses.sloka: तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं चास्यं ह्रस्वं ह्यकरवं वपुः ।तस्मिन् मुहूर्ते च पुनर्बभूवाङ्गुष्ठमात्रकः ।। ५.५८.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā vyāditaṁ cāsyaṁ hrasvaṁ hyakaravaṁ vapuḥ ।tasmin muhūrte ca punarbabhūvāṅguṣṭhamātrakaḥ ।। 5.58.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "She too opened her mouth wide enough for my size. Seeing her distending her mouth, in a moment I became small equal to the size of thumb and came out.
translations.hindi: इनको यहाँ का यहीं छोड़ दो और भाओ इम लोग वहाँ चलें जहाँ हमारे राजा विपुलग्रीव सुग्रीव श्री रामचन्द्रजी सहित विराजमान हैं

verses.sloka: अभिपत्याशु तद्वक्रं निर्गतो ऽहं ततः क्षणात् ।अब्रवीत् सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण मां पुनः ।। ५.५८.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: abhipatyāśu tadvakraṁ nirgato 'haṁ tataḥ kṣaṇāt ।abravīt surasā devī svena rūpeṇa māṁ punaḥ ।। 5.58.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then Surasa assumed her natural form again in a moment and said this to me:
translations.hindi: हम लोग चल कर अपने राजा से अङ्गद की शिकायत करेंगे। राजा क्रोधी स्वभाव के हैं ही, सो शिकायत सुन अवश्य ही इन वानरों को मार डालेंगे

verses.sloka: अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम् ।समानय च वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना ।सुखी भव महाबाहो प्रीता ऽस्मि तव वानर ।। ५.५८.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: arthasiddhyai hariśreṣṭha gaccha saumya yathāsukham ।samānaya ca vaidehīṁ rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।sukhī bhava mahābāho prītā 'smi tava vānara ।। 5.58.32 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O noble vanara O foremost of the vanaras go and accomplish the task.Unite the great Rama with Vaidehi.O strongarmed vanara, be happy. I am pleased with you'.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि यह मधुवन सुग्रीव को अत्यन्त प्यारा है। अधिकता यह है कि यह उनके बाप दादे के समय का है और बड़ा सुन्दर है । देवता लोग भी इसके भीतर नहीं जा सकते

verses.sloka: ततो ऽहं साधु साध्वीति सर्वभूतैः प्रशंसितः ।। ५.५८.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'haṁ sādhu sādhvīti sarvabhūtaiḥ praśaṁsitaḥ ।। 5.58.33 ।।

translations.english: "Then all creatures praised me saying 'well done well done'. Then I leaped into the vast sky like Garuda.

verses.sloka: वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना ।ततो ऽन्तरिक्षं विपुलं प्लुतो ऽहं गरुडो यथा ।छाया मे निगृहीता च न च पश्यामि किंचन ।। ५.५८.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vaidehīṁ rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।tato 'ntarikṣaṁ vipulaṁ pluto 'haṁ garuḍo yathā ।chāyā me nigṛhītā ca na ca paśyāmi kiṁcana ।। 5.58.34 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then I was captured by a shadow of some one. I could not see and I reduced my speed and looked around in all the ten directions. I could not see the one who seized me.
translations.hindi: ये सब दुष्ट, जो राजा की धवज्ञा करने वाले हैं, मार डालने ही योग्यः हैं। जब ये मार डाले जायेंगे तभी हम लोगों का यह श्रक्षमाजन्य क्रोध सार्थक होगा

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं विगतवेगस्तु दिशो दश विलोकयन् ।न किंचित्तत्र पश्यामि येन मे ऽपहृता गतिः ।। ५.५८.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ vigatavegastu diśo daśa vilokayan ।na kiṁcittatra paśyāmi yena me 'pahṛtā gatiḥ ।। 5.58.35 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then I was captured by a shadow of some one. I could not see and I reduced my speed and looked around in all the ten directions. I could not see the one who seized me.
translations.hindi: मधुवन के रखवालों से महाबली दधिमुख इस प्रकार कह उन भ्रनुचरों को लिए हुए सहसा उड़ा

verses.sloka: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना किं नाम गगने मम ।ईदृशो विघ्न उत्पन्नो रूपं यत्र न दृश्यते ।। ५.५८.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato me buddhirutpannā kiṁ nāma gagane mama ।īdṛśo vighna utpanno rūpaṁ yatra na dṛśyate ।। 5.58.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the thought arose in me: who is this in the sky, and what strange obstacle has arisen here, in which no form can be seen?

verses.sloka: अधोभागे न मे दृष्टिः शोचता पातिता मया ।ततो ऽद्राक्षमहं भीमां राक्षसीं सलिलेशयाम् ।। ५.५८.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adhobhāge na me dṛṣṭiḥ śocatā pātitā mayā ।tato 'drākṣamahaṁ bhīmāṁ rākṣasīṁ salileśayām ।। 5.58.37 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thinking so I looked down into the water and there I saw a terrific shedemon.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्य च महानादमुक्तो ऽहं भीमया तया ।अवस्थितमसम्भ्रान्तमिदं वाक्यमशोभनम् ।। ५.५८.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahasya ca mahānādamukto 'haṁ bhīmayā tayā ।avasthitamasambhrāntamidaṁ vākyamaśobhanam ।। 5.58.38 ।।।।

translations.english: "She was frightening and laughed in loud voice without any hesitation. Steadfast she uttered these ominous words to me:

verses.sloka: क्वासि यन्ता महाकाय क्षुधिताया ममेप्सितः ।भक्षः प्रीणय मे देहं चिरमाहारवर्जितम् ।। ५.५८.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kvāsi yantā mahākāya kṣudhitāyā mamepsitaḥ ।bhakṣaḥ prīṇaya me dehaṁ ciramāhāravarjitam ।। 5.58.39 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O huge monkey where are you going? I am hungry since long. I am going without food and must eat you. Make me satisfied'.

verses.sloka: बाढमित्येव तां वाणीं प्रत्यगृह्णामहं ततः ।आस्य प्रमाणादधिकं तस्याः कायमपूरयम् ।तस्याश्चास्यं महद्भीमं वर्धते मम भक्षणे ।। ५.५८.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bāḍhamityeva tāṁ vāṇīṁ pratyagṛhṇāmahaṁ tataḥ ।āsya pramāṇādadhikaṁ tasyāḥ kāyamapūrayam ।tasyāścāsyaṁ mahadbhīmaṁ vardhate mama bhakṣaṇe ।। 5.58.40 ।।।।

translations.english: "I said 'well' and enlarged my body more than her mouth could hold.

verses.transliteration: na ca māṁ sādhu bubudhe mama vā nikṛtaṁ kṛtam ।। 5.58.41 ।।।।

translations.english: "She opened her huge mouth to eat me as she did not know that I had already assumed a huge ugly form on my own.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽहं विपुलं रूपं संक्षिप्य निमिषान्तरात् ।तस्या हृदयमादाय प्रपतामि नभःस्थलम् ।। ५.५८.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'haṁ vipulaṁ rūpaṁ saṁkṣipya nimiṣāntarāt ।tasyā hṛdayamādāya prapatāmi nabhaḥsthalam ।। 5.58.42 ।।।।

translations.english: "In a moment I reduced from a huge form to a small one, entered her heart and sprang into the sky.

verses.sloka: सा विसृष्टभुजा भीमा पपात लवणाम्भसि ।मया पर्वतसङ्काशा निकृत्तहृदया सती ।। ५.५८.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā visṛṣṭabhujā bhīmā papāta lavaṇāmbhasi ।mayā parvatasaṅkāśā nikṛttahṛdayā satī ।। 5.58.43 ।।।।

translations.english: "She who resembled a mountain fell into the ocean with her arms hanging down when I pulled out her heart.

verses.sloka: श्रृणोमि खगतानां च सिद्धानां चारणैः सह ।राक्षसी सिंहिका भीमा क्षिप्रं हनुमता हता ।। ५.५८.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrṛṇomi khagatānāṁ ca siddhānāṁ cāraṇaiḥ saha ।rākṣasī siṁhikā bhīmā kṣipraṁ hanumatā hatā ।। 5.58.44 ।।।।

translations.english: "I heard the charanas and siddhas residing in the sky talking to each other that the fierce ogres Simhika has been killed by Hanuman in a moment.

verses.sloka: तां हत्वा पुनरेवाहं कृत्यमात्ययिकं स्मरन् ।गत्वा चाहं महाध्वानं पश्यामि नगमण्डितम् ।। ५.५८.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ hatvā punarevāhaṁ kṛtyamātyayikaṁ smaran ।gatvā cāhaṁ mahādhvānaṁ paśyāmi nagamaṇḍitam ।। 5.58.45 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having slained Simhika, I thought of the huge feat that I have done. I remembered the big mission before me and went to the southern shore of the ocean and saw Lanka full of trees.

verses.sloka: दक्षिणं तीरमुदधेर्लङ्का यत्र च सा पुरी ।अस्तं दिनकरे याते रक्षसां निलयं पुरम् ।प्रविष्टो ऽहमविज्ञातो रक्षोभि र्भीमविक्रमैः ।। ५.५८.४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaṁ tīramudadherlaṅkā yatra ca sā purī ।astaṁ dinakare yāte rakṣasāṁ nilayaṁ puram ।praviṣṭo 'hamavijñāto rakṣobhi rbhīmavikramaiḥ ।। 5.58.46 ।।।।

translations.english: After the sun had set, I, of fierce valour, entered unnoticed the guarded city, the abode of the demons.

verses.sloka: तत्र प्रविशतश्चापि कल्पान्तघनसन्निभा ।अट्टहासं विमुञ्चन्ती नारी काप्युत्थिता पुरः ।। ५.५८.४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatra praviśataścāpi kalpāntaghanasannibhā ।aṭṭahāsaṁ vimuñcantī nārī kāpyutthitā puraḥ ।। 5.58.47 ।।।।

translations.english: As I entered the city, a woman like a doomsday cloud rose up before me, yelling and laughing wildly, opposing me.

verses.sloka: जिघांसन्तीं ततस्तां तु ज्वलदग्निशिरोरुहाम् ।सव्यमुष्टिप्रहारेण पराजित्य सुभैरवाम् ।। ५.५८.४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jighāṁsantīṁ tatastāṁ tu jvaladagniśiroruhām ।savyamuṣṭiprahāreṇa parājitya subhairavām ।। 5.58.48 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.

verses.sloka: प्रदोषकाले प्रविशं भीतया ऽहं तयोदितः ।अहं लङ्कापुरी वीर निर्जिता विक्रमेण ते ।। ५.५८.४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pradoṣakāle praviśaṁ bhītayā 'haṁ tayoditaḥ ।ahaṁ laṅkāpurī vīra nirjitā vikrameṇa te ।। 5.58.49 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.

verses.sloka: यस्मात्तस्माद्विजेतासि सर्व रक्षांस्यशेषतः ।। ५.५८.५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yasmāttasmādvijetāsi sarva rakṣāṁsyaśeṣataḥ ।। 5.58.50 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O hero I am the presiding deity of Lanka whom you have won by your valour. Therefore you will win many demons she foretold.

verses.sloka: तत्राहं सर्वरात्रं तु विचिन्वन् जनकात्मजाम् ।रावणान्तःपुरगतो न चापश्यं सुमध्यमाम् ।। ५.५८.५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatrāhaṁ sarvarātraṁ tu vicinvan janakātmajām ।rāvaṇāntaḥpuragato na cāpaśyaṁ sumadhyamām ।। 5.58.51 ।।।।

translations.english: "There when I went to the harem of Ravana and searched all night, I did not find the fairwaisted Janaka's daughter.

verses.sloka: ततः सीतामपश्यंस्तु रावणस्य निवेशने ।शोकसागरमासाद्य न पारमुपलक्षये ।। ५.५८.५२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sītāmapaśyaṁstu rāvaṇasya niveśane ।śokasāgaramāsādya na pāramupalakṣaye ।। 5.58.52 ।।।।

translations.english: "Not able to find Sita at the residence of Ravana I was immersed in an ocean of endless sorrow and did not know what to do.

verses.sloka: शोचता च मया दृष्टं प्राकारेण समावृतम् ।काञ्चनेन विकृष्टेन गृहोपवनमुत्तमम् ।। ५.५८.५३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śocatā ca mayā dṛṣṭaṁ prākāreṇa samāvṛtam ।kāñcanena vikṛṣṭena gṛhopavanamuttamam ।। 5.58.53 ।।।।

translations.english: "While worrying like that I saw a long golden boundary wall surrounding a splendid home garden. (upabana)

verses.sloka: स प्राकारमवप्लुत्य पश्यामि बहुपादपम् ।। ५.५८.५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa prākāramavaplutya paśyāmi bahupādapam ।। 5.58.54 ।।।।

translations.english: "I crossed that boundary wall and saw many kinds of trees and in the midst of that Ashoka garden, a huge Simsupa tree. I ascended it and saw rows of banana plants.

verses.sloka: अशोकवनिकामध्ये शिंशुपापादपो महान् ।तमारुह्य च पश्यामि काञ्चनं कदलीवनम् ।। ५.५८.५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāmadhye śiṁśupāpādapo mahān ।tamāruhya ca paśyāmi kāñcanaṁ kadalīvanam ।। 5.58.55 ।।।।

translations.english: "Not far from the Simsupa tree I saw beautiful Sita, of dark complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, whose face was emaciated due to fasting, wearing only a single sari (the same one since her abduction) her locks filled with dust, pathetic looking, immersed in sorrow, meditating on her husband seated like a doe encircled by tigresses, surrounded by ugly and cruel shedemons fed on flesh and blood.

verses.sloka: अदूरे शिंशुपावृक्षात् पश्यामि वरवर्णिनीम् ।श्यामां कमलपत्राक्षीमुपवासकृशाननाम् ।। ५.५८.५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adūre śiṁśupāvṛkṣāt paśyāmi varavarṇinīm ।śyāmāṁ kamalapatrākṣīmupavāsakṛśānanām ।। 5.58.56 ।।।।

translations.english: "Not far from the Simsupa tree I saw beautiful Sita, of dark complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, whose face was emaciated due to fasting, wearing only a single sari (the same one since her abduction) her locks filled with dust, pathetic looking, immersed in sorrow, meditating on her husband seated like a doe encircled by tigresses, surrounded by ugly and cruel shedemons fed on flesh and blood.

verses.sloka: तदेकवासःसंवीतां रजोध्वस्तशिरोरुहाम् ।शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गीं सीतां भर्तृहिते स्थिताम् ।। ५.५८.५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadekavāsaḥsaṁvītāṁ rajodhvastaśiroruhām ।śokasantāpadīnāṅgīṁ sītāṁ bhartṛhite sthitām ।। 5.58.57 ।।।।

translations.english: "Not far from the Simsupa tree I saw beautiful Sita, of dark complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, whose face was emaciated due to fasting, wearing only a single sari (the same one since her abduction) her locks filled with dust, pathetic looking, immersed in sorrow, meditating on her husband seated like a doe encircled by tigresses, surrounded by ugly and cruel shedemons fed on flesh and blood.

verses.sloka: राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिः क्रूराभिरभिसंवृताम् ।मांसशोणितभक्षाभिर्व्याघ्रीभिर्हरिणीमिव ।। ५.५८.५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasībhirvirūpābhiḥ krūrābhirabhisaṁvṛtām ।māṁsaśoṇitabhakṣābhirvyāghrībhirhariṇīmiva ।। 5.58.58 ।।।।

translations.english: After much searching I at last beheld her amid the demonesses, repeatedly intimidated—wearing a single braid, miserable, absorbed in thought of her husband, pale from lying on the bare ground like a lotus at winter's onset, turned away from Ravana and resolved to die.

verses.sloka: सामया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा ।। ५.५८.५९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāmayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā ।। 5.58.59 ।।।।

translations.english: After much searching I at last beheld her amid the demonesses, repeatedly intimidated—wearing a single braid, miserable, absorbed in thought of her husband, pale from lying on the bare ground like a lotus at winter's onset, turned away from Ravana and resolved to die.

verses.sloka: भूमिशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पझिनीव हिमागमे ।रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया ।कथंचिन्मृगशावाक्षी तूर्णमासादिता मया ।। ५.५८.६० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhūmiśayyā vivarṇāṅgī pajhinīva himāgame ।rāvaṇādvinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā ।kathaṁcinmṛgaśāvākṣī tūrṇamāsāditā mayā ।। 5.58.60 ।।।।

translations.english: After much searching I at last beheld her amid the demonesses, repeatedly intimidated—wearing a single braid, miserable, absorbed in thought of her husband, pale from lying on the bare ground like a lotus at winter's onset, turned away from Ravana and resolved to die.

verses.sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा तादृशीं नारीं रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम् ।तत्रैव शिंशुपावृक्षे पश्यन्नहमवस्थितः ।। ५.५८.६१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṁ nārīṁ rāmapatnīṁ yaśasvinīm ।tatraiva śiṁśupāvṛkṣe paśyannahamavasthitaḥ ।। 5.58.61 ।।।।

translations.english: "I remained there looking on that renowned wife of Rama from the Simsupa tree.

verses.sloka: ततो हलहलाशब्दं काञ्चीनूपुरमिश्रितम् ।शृणोम्यधिकगम्भीरं रावणस्य निवेशने ।। ५.५८.६२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato halahalāśabdaṁ kāñcīnūpuramiśritam ।śṛṇomyadhikagambhīraṁ rāvaṇasya niveśane ।। 5.58.62 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then I heard a deep sound mixed with jingling golden girdles and anklets coming from Ravana's residence.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽहं परमोद्विग्नः स्वं रूपं प्रतिसंहरन् ।अहं तु शिंशुपावृक्षे पक्षीव गहने स्थितः ।। ५.५८.६३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'haṁ paramodvignaḥ svaṁ rūpaṁ pratisaṁharan ।ahaṁ tu śiṁśupāvṛkṣe pakṣīva gahane sthitaḥ ।। 5.58.63 ।।।।

translations.english: "I was scared and contracted my body size and stood on the Simsupa tree like a bird in the sky.

verses.sloka: ततो रावणदाराश्च रावणश्च महाबलः ।तं देशं समनुप्राप्त यत्र सीता ऽभवत् स्थिता ।। ५.५८.६४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāvaṇadārāśca rāvaṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।taṁ deśaṁ samanuprāpta yatra sītā 'bhavat sthitā ।। 5.58.64 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then arrived the powerful Ravana with his consorts to that place where Sita was and stood there.

verses.sloka: तद् दृष्ट्वा ऽथ वरारोहा सीता रक्षोमहाबलम् ।सङ्कुच्योरू स्तनौ पीनौ बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्य च ।। ५.५८.६५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tad dṛṣṭvā 'tha varārohā sītā rakṣomahābalam ।saṅkucyorū stanau pīnau bāhubhyāṁ parirabhya ca ।। 5.58.65 ।।।।

translations.english: "On seeing Ravana, the king of demons, beautiful Sita, full of fear hid her face and plump breasts between her thighs.

verses.sloka: वित्रस्तां परमोद्विग्नां वीक्षमाणां ततस्ततः ।त्राणं किंचिदपश्यन्तीं वेपमानां तपस्विनीम् ।। ५.५८.६६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vitrastāṁ paramodvignāṁ vīkṣamāṇāṁ tatastataḥ ।trāṇaṁ kiṁcidapaśyantīṁ vepamānāṁ tapasvinīm ।। 5.58.66 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sita was full of fear and worry, looked here and there without any protector to pacify. She was trembling in fear. To that Sita, the tenheaded Ravana bent his head down and said, 'trust me and respect me'.

verses.sloka: तामुवाच दशग्रीवः सीतां परमदुःखिताम् ।अवाक्छिराः प्रपतितो बहुमन्यस्व मामिति ।। ५.५८.६७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāmuvāca daśagrīvaḥ sītāṁ paramaduḥkhitām ।avākchirāḥ prapatito bahumanyasva māmiti ।। 5.58.67 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sita was full of fear and worry, looked here and there without any protector to pacify. She was trembling in fear. To that Sita, the tenheaded Ravana bent his head down and said, 'trust me and respect me'.

verses.sloka: यदि चेत्त्वं तु दर्पान्मां नाभिनन्दसि गर्विते ।द्वौ मासावन्तरं सीते पास्यामि रुधिरं तव ।। ५.५८.६८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi cettvaṁ tu darpānmāṁ nābhinandasi garvite ।dvau māsāvantaraṁ sīte pāsyāmi rudhiraṁ tava ।। 5.58.68 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita if in your pride, you do not respect me, I will see (drink) your blood in two months.

verses.sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।उवाच परमक्रुद्धा सीता वचनमुत्तमम् ।। ५.५८.६९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā vacastasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।uvāca paramakruddhā sītā vacanamuttamam ।। 5.58.69 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hearing the words of evilminded Ravana, Sita became very angry and spoke these approprate words:

verses.sloka: राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्यममिततेजसः ।इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथस्य स्नुषां दशरथस्य च ।अवाच्यं वदतो जिह्वा कथं न पतिता तव ।। ५.५८.७० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasādhama rāmasya bhāryamamitatejasaḥ ।ikṣvākukulanāthasya snuṣāṁ daśarathasya ca ।avācyaṁ vadato jihvā kathaṁ na patitā tava ।। 5.58.70 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O lowly demon I am the wife of valiant Rama and daughterinlaw of Dasaratha, the king of Ikshvaku race. How is it your tongue that spoke unspeakable words has not fallen down?

verses.sloka: किंचिद्वीर्यं तवानार्य यो मां भर्तुरसन्निधौ ।अपहृत्यागतः पाप तेनादृष्टो महात्मना ।। ५.५८.७१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁcidvīryaṁ tavānārya yo māṁ bharturasannidhau ।apahṛtyāgataḥ pāpa tenādṛṣṭo mahātmanā ।। 5.58.71 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O ignoble one when my husband was away, you came and abducted me unseen by the great Rama. You do not have even a little courage (to win me through a straight fight).

verses.sloka: न त्वं रामस्य सदृशो दास्ये ऽप्यस्य न युज्यसे ।यज्ञीयः सत्यवादी च रणश्लाघी च राघवः ।। ५.५८.७२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na tvaṁ rāmasya sadṛśo dāsye 'pyasya na yujyase ।yajñīyaḥ satyavādī ca raṇaślāghī ca rāghavaḥ ।। 5.58.72 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You are not equal to Rama and not even fit to be his servant. He does yagnas and always abides in truth. He is valiant in war.

verses.sloka: जानक्या परुषं वाक्यमेवमुक्तो दशाननः ।जज्वाल सहसा कोपच्चितास्थ इव पावकः ।। ५.५८.७३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jānakyā paruṣaṁ vākyamevamukto daśānanaḥ ।jajvāla sahasā kopaccitāstha iva pāvakaḥ ।। 5.58.73 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thus addressed harshly by Janaki, the tenheaded Ravana blazed up in anger suddenly like the flame of the funeral pyre.

verses.sloka: विवर्त्य नयने क्रूरे मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।मैथिलीं हन्तुमारब्धः स्त्रीभिर्हा हा कृतं तदा ।। ५.५८.७४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vivartya nayane krūre muṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam ।maithilīṁ hantumārabdhaḥ strībhirhā hā kṛtaṁ tadā ।। 5.58.74 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the wicked Ravana raised his eyebrows and his right fist to strike at Sita and even the shedemon there raised their voice saying, ' alas, alas '

verses.sloka: स्त्रीणां मध्यात् समुत्पत्य तस्य भार्या दुरात्मनः ।वरा मण्डोदरी नाम तया स प्रतिषेधितः ।। ५.५८.७५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: strīṇāṁ madhyāt samutpatya tasya bhāryā durātmanaḥ ।varā maṇḍodarī nāma tayā sa pratiṣedhitaḥ ।। 5.58.75 ।।।।

translations.english: "Evilminded Ravana's wife Mandodari, a noble one among women came forward from the midst and prevented him.

verses.sloka: उक्तश्च मधुरां वाणीं तया स मदानार्दितः ।सीतया तव किं कार्यं महेन्द्रसमविक्रम ।। ५.५८.७६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uktaśca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ tayā sa madānārditaḥ ।sītayā tava kiṁ kāryaṁ mahendrasamavikrama ।। 5.58.76 ।।।।

translations.english: "She spoke sweetly to Ravana, who was tormented by the god of love saying, 'For what purpose do you desire Sita? You are equal to Mahendra in might'.

verses.sloka: देवगन्दर्वकान्याभिर्यक्षकन्याभिरेव च ।सार्धं प्रभो रमस्वेह सीतया किं करिष्यसि ।। ५.५८.७७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: devagandarvakānyābhiryakṣakanyābhireva ca ।sārdhaṁ prabho ramasveha sītayā kiṁ kariṣyasi ।। 5.58.77 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O lord you enjoy with the daughters of gods, gandharvas and even the young ladies of yakshas. Why do you need Sita?'

verses.sloka: ततस्ताभिः समेताभिर्नारीभिः स महाबलः ।प्रसाद्य सहसा नीतो भवनं स्वं निशाचरः ।। ५.५८.७८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastābhiḥ sametābhirnārībhiḥ sa mahābalaḥ ।prasādya sahasā nīto bhavanaṁ svaṁ niśācaraḥ ।। 5.58.78 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then all the women got together and stopped the mighty nightranger, Ravana and quickly took him back to his mansion.

verses.sloka: याते तस्मिन् दशग्रीवे राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः ।सीतां निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सुदारुणैः ।। ५.५८.७९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāte tasmin daśagrīve rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ।sītāṁ nirbhartsayāmāsurvākyaiḥ krūraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ।। 5.58.79 ।।।।

translations.english: When that ten-headed one had gone, the ugly-faced demonesses threatened Sita with cruel and frightful words.

verses.sloka: तृणवद्भाषितं तासां गणयामास जानकी ।गर्जितं च तदा तासां सीतां प्राप्य निरर्थकम् ।। ५.५८.८० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tṛṇavadbhāṣitaṁ tāsāṁ gaṇayāmāsa jānakī ।garjitaṁ ca tadā tāsāṁ sītāṁ prāpya nirarthakam ।। 5.58.80 ।।।।

translations.english: "Janaki did not care for their words of threat, as though they were a blade of grass and of no use to her.

verses.sloka: वृथागर्जितनिश्चेष्टा राक्षस्यः पिशिताशनाः ।रावणाय शशंसुस्ताः सीताध्यवसितं महत् ।। ५.५८.८१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vṛthāgarjitaniśceṣṭā rākṣasyaḥ piśitāśanāḥ ।rāvaṇāya śaśaṁsustāḥ sītādhyavasitaṁ mahat ।। 5.58.81 ।।।।

translations.english: "Since the threatenings of the shedemons were of no use the ogresses who live on flesh and blood reported to Ravana about great Sita's formidable determination.

verses.sloka: ततस्ताः सहिताः सर्वा विहताशा निरुद्यमाः ।परिक्षिप्य समन्तात्तां निद्रावशमुपागताः ।। ५.५८.८२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastāḥ sahitāḥ sarvā vihatāśā nirudyamāḥ ।parikṣipya samantāttāṁ nidrāvaśamupāgatāḥ ।। 5.58.82 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then all of them gave up hope of their efforts and scattered around her, succumbed to sleep.

verses.sloka: तासु चैव प्रसुप्तासु सीता भर्तृहिते रता ।विलप्य करुणं दीना प्रशुशोच सुदुःखिता ।। ५.५८.८३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāsu caiva prasuptāsu sītā bhartṛhite ratā ।vilapya karuṇaṁ dīnā praśuśoca suduḥkhitā ।। 5.58.83 ।।।।

translations.english: When they had fallen asleep, the devoted Sita, miserable and grief-stricken, lamented pitifully.

verses.sloka: तासां मध्यात् समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति ।। ५.५८.८४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāsāṁ madhyāt samutthāya trijaṭā vākyamabravīt ।ātmānaṁ khādata kṣipraṁ na sītā vinaśiṣyati ।। 5.58.84 ।।।।

translations.english: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

verses.sloka: जनकस्यात्मजा साध्वी स्नुषा दशरथस्य च ।स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः ।। ५.५८.८५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: janakasyātmajā sādhvī snuṣā daśarathasya ca ।svapno hyadya mayā dṛṣṭo dāruṇo romaharṣaṇaḥ ।। 5.58.85 ।।।।

translations.english: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

verses.sloka: रक्षसां च विनाशाय भर्तुरस्या जयाय च ।। ५.५८.८६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣasāṁ ca vināśāya bharturasyā jayāya ca ।। 5.58.86 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Today I saw in my dream, a dreadful and horripilating scene of destruction of demons and even victory of Sita's husband.

verses.sloka: अलमस्मात् परित्रातुं राघवाद्राक्षसीगणम् ।अभियाचाम वैदेहीमेतद्धि मम रोचते ।। ५.५८.८७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: alamasmāt paritrātuṁ rāghavādrākṣasīgaṇam ।abhiyācāma vaidehīmetaddhi mama rocate ।। 5.58.87 ।।।।

translations.english: 'To protect the demon clan from destruction by Rama, it is enough if we beg her (pardon). Indeed, I think that way.

verses.sloka: यस्या ह्येवंविधः स्वप्नो दुःखितायाः प्रदृश्यते ।सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता सुखमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ।। ५.५८.८८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yasyā hyevaṁvidhaḥ svapno duḥkhitāyāḥ pradṛśyate ।sā duḥkhairvividhairmuktā sukhamāpnotyanuttamam ।। 5.58.88 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Whoever in a sorrowful state sees such kind of dream, would be not only relieved of all sorrows but will experience immense happiness. Janaka's daughter Sita will bless us with protection if we pray her.

verses.sloka: प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।। ५.५८.८९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: praṇipātaprasannā hi maithilī janakātmajā ।। 5.58.89 ।।।।

translations.english: 'On hearing the words (of Trijata) that 'Rama will succeed', young and bashful Sita felt happy and said that 'If it comes true I will protect thee'.

verses.sloka: ततः सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तुर्विजयहर्षिता ।अवोचद्यदि तत्तथ्यं भवेयं शरणं हि वः ।। ५.५८.९० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā hrīmatī bālā bharturvijayaharṣitā ।avocadyadi tattathyaṁ bhaveyaṁ śaraṇaṁ hi vaḥ ।। 5.58.90 ।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing Sita's deplorable state, her illluck and her dread, I began to worry and had no peace of mind.

verses.sloka: तां चाहं तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा सीताया दारुणां दशाम् ।चिन्तयामास विक्रान्तो न च मे निर्वृतं मनः ।। ५.५८.९१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ cāhaṁ tādṛśīṁ dṛṣṭvā sītāyā dāruṇāṁ daśām ।cintayāmāsa vikrānto na ca me nirvṛtaṁ manaḥ ।। 5.58.91 ।।।।

translations.english: "I thought of a strategy to enter into conversation with Janaki that is to praise the Ikshvaku race.

verses.sloka: सम्भाषणाथ च मया जानक्याश्चिन्तितो विधिः ।इक्ष्वाकूणां हि वशस्तु ततो मम पुरस्कृतः ।। ५.५८.९२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sambhāṣaṇātha ca mayā jānakyāścintito vidhiḥ ।ikṣvākūṇāṁ hi vaśastu tato mama puraskṛtaḥ ।। 5.58.92 ।।।।

translations.english: "The divine lady heard my enumeration, sanctifying the royal seers. She replied me, with her eyes blinded by tears:

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु गदितां वाचं राजर्षिगणपूजिताम् ।प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना ।। ५.५८.९३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu gaditāṁ vācaṁ rājarṣigaṇapūjitām ।pratyabhāṣata māṁ devī bāṣpaiḥ pihitalocanā ।। 5.58.93 ।।।।

translations.english: "O foremost of vanaras who are you? Why and how have you come here? How did you make friendship with Rama? Tell me all that in detail.

verses.sloka: कस्त्वं केन कथं चेह प्राप्तो वानरपुङ्गव ।का च रामेण ते प्रीतिस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि ।। ५.५८.९४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kastvaṁ kena kathaṁ ceha prāpto vānarapuṅgava ।kā ca rāmeṇa te prītistanme śaṁsitumarhasi ।। 5.58.94 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.

verses.sloka: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यहमप्यब्रवं वचः ।देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः ।सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः ।। ५.५८.९५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā hyahamapyabravaṁ vacaḥ ।devi rāmasya bhartuste sahāyo bhīmavikramaḥ ।sugrīvo nāma vikrānto vānarendro mahābalaḥ ।। 5.58.95 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.

verses.sloka: तस्य मां विद्धि भृत्यं त्वं हनुमन्तमिहागतम् ।भर्त्रा ऽहं प्रेषितस्तुभ्यं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ।। ५.५८.९६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya māṁ viddhi bhṛtyaṁ tvaṁ hanumantamihāgatam ।bhartrā 'haṁ preṣitastubhyaṁ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।। 5.58.96 ।।।।

translations.english: 'I came here as a servant sent by your tireless husband to find you.

verses.sloka: इदं च पुरुषव्याघ्रः श्रीमान् दाशरथिः स्वयम् ।अङ्गुलीयमभिज्ञानमदात्तुभ्यं यशस्विनि ।। ५.५८.९७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: idaṁ ca puruṣavyāghraḥ śrīmān dāśarathiḥ svayam ।aṅgulīyamabhijñānamadāttubhyaṁ yaśasvini ।। 5.58.97 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O glorious lady the tiger among men, the illustrious son of Dasaratha himself sent this ring to you as a taken of identity.

verses.sloka: तदिच्छामि त्वया ऽ ऽज्ञप्तं देवि किं करवाण्यहम् ।रामलक्ष्मणयोः पार्श्वं नयामि त्वां किमुत्तरम् ।। ५.५८.९८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadicchāmi tvayā ' 'jñaptaṁ devi kiṁ karavāṇyaham ।rāmalakṣmaṇayoḥ pārśvaṁ nayāmi tvāṁ kimuttaram ।। 5.58.98 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O venerable lady I seek your order. What should I do? Should I take you to Rama and Lakshmana? What do you say?

verses.sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च सीता जनकनन्दिनी ।आह रावणमुत्साद्य राघवो मां नयत्विति ।। ५.५८.९९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā viditvā ca sītā janakanandinī ।āha rāvaṇamutsādya rāghavo māṁ nayatviti ।। 5.58.99 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard all that (Hanuman said) Sita, the delight of Janaka thought over and said, 'Rama should kill Ravana and take me'.

verses.sloka: प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीमहमार्यामनिन्दिताम् ।राघवस्य मनोह्लादमभिज्ञानमयाचिषम् ।। ५.५८.१०० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā devīmahamāryāmaninditām ।rāghavasya manohlādamabhijñānamayāciṣam ।। 5.58.100 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then bowing down I saluted the noble and blameless queen Sita to give a signet, which would be very pleasing to Rama.

verses.sloka: अथ मामब्रवीत् सीता गृह्यतामयमुत्तमः ।मणिर्येन महाबाहू रामस्त्वां बहुमन्यते ।। ५.५८.१०१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha māmabravīt sītā gṛhyatāmayamuttamaḥ ।maṇiryena mahābāhū rāmastvāṁ bahumanyate ।। 5.58.101 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sita then said to me, 'Take this best of gems and present it to the longarmed Rama as a token'.

verses.sloka: इत्यक्त्वा तु वरारोहा मणिप्रवरमद्भुतम् ।प्रायच्छत् परमोद्विग्ना वाचा मां संदिदेश ह ।। ५.५८.१०२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityaktvā tu varārohā maṇipravaramadbhutam ।prāyacchat paramodvignā vācā māṁ saṁdideśa ha ।। 5.58.102 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having said so, the noble lady delivered a wonderful jewel with supreme message to me in a sorrowful mood.

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्यै प्रणम्याहं राजपुत्र्यैः समाहितः ।प्रदक्षिणं परिक्राममिहाभ्युद्गतमानसः ।। ५.५८.१०३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasyai praṇamyāhaṁ rājaputryaiḥ samāhitaḥ ।pradakṣiṇaṁ parikrāmamihābhyudgatamānasaḥ ।। 5.58.103 ।।।।

translations.english: "Reminded by her again (that Rama should turn up soon to take her), I offered reverential salutations by circumambulating her.

verses.sloka: उत्तरं पुनरेवेदं निश्चित्य मनसा तया ।हनुमन् मम वृत्तान्तं वक्तुमर्हसि राघवे ।। ५.५८.१०४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uttaraṁ punarevedaṁ niścitya manasā tayā ।hanuman mama vṛttāntaṁ vaktumarhasi rāghave ।। 5.58.104 ।।।।

translations.english: Having resolved it in her mind, she spoke to me once more: Hanuman, you ought to relate my plight to Rama.

verses.sloka: यथा श्रुत्वैव नचिरात्तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।सुग्रीवसहितौ वीरावुपेयातां तथा कुरु ।। ५.५८.१०५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathā śrutvaiva nacirāttāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।sugrīvasahitau vīrāvupeyātāṁ tathā kuru ।। 5.58.105 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O heroic Hanuman narrate in such a way that by hearing you both Rama and Lakshmana will come here soon, accompanied by Sugriva.

verses.sloka: यद्यन्यथा भवेदेतद्द्वौ मासौ जीवितं मम ।न मां द्रक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थो म्रिये सा ऽहमनाथवत् ।। ५.५८.१०६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadyanyathā bhavedetaddvau māsau jīvitaṁ mama ।na māṁ drakṣyati kākutstho mriye sā 'hamanāthavat ।। 5.58.106 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Otherwise with none to protect me, I will live only for two months.I will die like an orphan and he will not see me'.

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा करुणं वाक्यं क्रोधो मामभ्यवर्तत ।उत्तरं च मया दृष्टं कार्यशेषमनन्तरम् ।। ५.५८.१०७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā karuṇaṁ vākyaṁ krodho māmabhyavartata ।uttaraṁ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṁ kāryaśeṣamanantaram ।। 5.58.107 ।।।।

translations.english: "When I heard her pathetic appeal, I was overtaken by anger. I perceived the task left over for me to do.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽवर्धत मे कायस्तदा पर्वतसन्निभः ।युद्धकाङ्क्षी वनं तच्च विनाशयितुमारभे ।। ५.५८.१०८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'vardhata me kāyastadā parvatasannibhaḥ ।yuddhakāṅkṣī vanaṁ tacca vināśayitumārabhe ।। 5.58.108 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thereafter, I increased my body to the size of a mountain, intent on fighting and started destroying the pleasure garden.

verses.sloka: तद्भग्नं वनषण्डं तु भ्रान्तत्रस्तमृगद्विजम् ।प्रतिबुद्धा निरीक्षन्ते राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः ।। ५.५८.१०९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadbhagnaṁ vanaṣaṇḍaṁ tu bhrāntatrastamṛgadvijam ।pratibuddhā nirīkṣante rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ।। 5.58.109 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those uglyfaced ogresses woke up and saw the devastated garden and terrified beasts and birds.

verses.sloka: मां च दृष्ट्वा वने तस्मिन् समागम्य ततस्ततः ।ताः समभ्यागताः क्षिप्रं रावणायाचचक्षिरे ।। ५.५८.११० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: māṁ ca dṛṣṭvā vane tasmin samāgamya tatastataḥ ।tāḥ samabhyāgatāḥ kṣipraṁ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire ।। 5.58.110 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing me in that garden and gathering from here and there, the demonesses at once understood and reported it to Ravana.

verses.sloka: राजन् वनमिदं दुर्गं तव भग्नं दुरात्मना ।वानरेण ह्यविज्ञाय तव वीर्यं महाबल ।। ५.५८.१११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rājan vanamidaṁ durgaṁ tava bhagnaṁ durātmanā ।vānareṇa hyavijñāya tava vīryaṁ mahābala ।। 5.58.111 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O powerful king an evilminded vanara has destroyed the inaccessible pleasure garden not knowing your valour.

verses.sloka: दुर्बुद्धेस्तस्य राजेन्द्र तव विप्रियकारिणः ।वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथा ऽसौ विलयं व्रजेत् ।। ५.५८.११२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: durbuddhestasya rājendra tava vipriyakāriṇaḥ ।vadhamājñāpaya kṣipraṁ yathā 'sau vilayaṁ vrajet ।। 5.58.112 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O king may orders be issued to kill this wickedminded vanara wandering aimlessly. He has done contrary to your interest.

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा भृशदुर्जयाः ।राक्षसाः किङ्करा नाम रावणस्य मनोनुगाः ।। ५.५८.११३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā rākṣasendreṇa visṛṣṭā bhṛśadurjayāḥ ।rākṣasāḥ kiṅkarā nāma rāvaṇasya manonugāḥ ।। 5.58.113 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana, lord of the demons having heard (the ogresses) sent invincible ogres called kinkaras who know his mind.

verses.sloka: तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं शूलमुद्गरपाणिनाम् ।मया तस्मिन् वनोद्देशे परिघेण निषूदितम् ।। ५.५८.११४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmaśītisāhasraṁ śūlamudgarapāṇinām ।mayā tasmin vanoddeśe parigheṇa niṣūditam ।। 5.58.114 ।।।।

translations.english: "I killed with an iron bar a battalion of eighty thousand demons who were guarding the garden with tridents and maces.

verses.sloka: तेषां तु हतशेषा ये ते गत्वा लघुविक्रमाः ।निहतं च महत्सैन्यं रावणायाचचक्षिरे ।। ५.५८.११५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tu hataśeṣā ye te gatvā laghuvikramāḥ ।nihataṁ ca mahatsainyaṁ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire ।। 5.58.115 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those who were left behind, the less powerful ones went and reported to Ravana that the great army has been killed.

verses.sloka: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना चैत्यप्रासादमाक्रमम् ।तत्रस्थान् राक्षसान् हत्वा शतं स्तम्भेन वै पुनः ।ललामभूतो लङ्कायाः स वै विध्वंसितो मया ।। ५.५८.११६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato me buddhirutpannā caityaprāsādamākramam ।tatrasthān rākṣasān hatvā śataṁ stambhena vai punaḥ ।lalāmabhūto laṅkāyāḥ sa vai vidhvaṁsito mayā ।। 5.58.116 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then a thought struck my mind. I took hold of a pillar of the tall, decorated mansion of Lanka and killed with it all the hundred demons stationed there.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहस्तस्य सुतं जम्बुमालिनमादिशत् ।राक्षसैर्बहुभिः सार्धं घोररूपैर्भयानकैः ।। ५.५८.११७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahastasya sutaṁ jambumālinamādiśat ।rākṣasairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṁ ghorarūpairbhayānakaiḥ ।। 5.58.117 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Ravana ordered out Jambumali, son of Prahasta, together with many demons of terrific and frightening appearance.

verses.sloka: तमहं बलसम्पन्नं राक्षसं रणकोविदम् ।परिघेणातिघोरेण सूदयामि सहानुगम् ।। ५.५८.११८ ।।५.५८.११७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamahaṁ balasampannaṁ rākṣasaṁ raṇakovidam ।parigheṇātighoreṇa sūdayāmi sahānugam ।। 5.58.118 ।।5.58.117 ।।।।

translations.english: "With a dreadful iron bar I slayed Jambumali, who was endowed with mighty strength, and was an expert in war and other terrific ogres who accompanied him.

verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā rākṣasendrastu mantriputrān mahābalān ।। 5.58.119 ।।m ।। 5.58.118 ।।5.58.117 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana, the demon king sent his mighty army of strong footsoldiers, the sons of ministers.

verses.sloka: पदातिबलसम्पन्नान् प्रेषयामास रावणः ।परिघेणैव तान् सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम् ।। ५.५८.१२० ।।११७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: padātibalasampannān preṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।parigheṇaiva tān sarvānnayāmi yamasādanam ।। 5.58.120 ।।117 ।।।।

translations.english: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana sent five heroic army generals.

verses.sloka: मन्त्रिपुत्रान् हताञ्छ्रुत्वा समरे लघुविक्रमान् ।पञ्च सेनाग्रगाञ्छूरान् प्रेषयमास रावणः ।। ५.५८.१२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mantriputrān hatāñchrutvā samare laghuvikramān ।pañca senāgragāñchūrān preṣayamāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.58.121 ।।।।

translations.english: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana sent five heroic army generals.

verses.sloka: तानहं सहसैन्यान् वै सर्वानेवाभ्यसूदयम् ।ततः पुनर्दशग्रीवः पुत्रमक्षं महाबलम् ।। ५.५८.१२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tānahaṁ sahasainyān vai sarvānevābhyasūdayam ।tataḥ punardaśagrīvaḥ putramakṣaṁ mahābalam ।। 5.58.122 ।।।।

translations.english: "Since I killed all of them along with the army, the tenheaded Ravana sent out his mighty son Aksha together with many demons.

verses.sloka: बहुभी राक्षसैः सार्धं प्रेषयामास रावणः ।तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम् ।। ५.५८.१२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bahubhī rākṣasaiḥ sārdhaṁ preṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।taṁ tu mandodarīputraṁ kumāraṁ raṇapaṇḍitam ।। 5.58.123 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.

verses.sloka: सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान् ।चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम् ।तमक्षमागतं भग्नं निशम्य स दशाननः ।। ५.५८.१२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sahasā khaṁ samutkrāntaṁ pādayośca gṛhītavān ।carmāsinaṁ śataguṇaṁ bhrāmayitvā vyapeṣayam ।tamakṣamāgataṁ bhagnaṁ niśamya sa daśānanaḥ ।। 5.58.124 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.

verses.sloka: तत इन्द्रजितं नाम द्वितीयं रावणः सुतम् ।व्यादिदेश सुसंक्रुद्धो बलिनं युद्धदुर्मदम् ।। ५.५८.१२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tata indrajitaṁ nāma dvitīyaṁ rāvaṇaḥ sutam ।vyādideśa susaṁkruddho balinaṁ yuddhadurmadam ।। 5.58.125 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Aksha was done to death, the tenfaced Ravana was enraged and gave instruction to the second son, called Indrajit who was thirsting for war.

verses.sloka: तच्चाप्यहं बलं सर्वं तं च राक्षसपुङ्गवम् ।नष्टौजसं रणे कृत्वा परं हर्षमुपागमम् ।। ५.५८.१२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taccāpyahaṁ balaṁ sarvaṁ taṁ ca rākṣasapuṅgavam ।naṣṭaujasaṁ raṇe kṛtvā paraṁ harṣamupāgamam ।। 5.58.126 ।।।।

translations.english: "When the army and even the Generals were done to death in combat I was very happy.

verses.sloka: महतापि महाबाहुः प्रत्ययेन महाबलः ।प्रेषितो रावणेनैव सह वीरैर्मदोत्कटैः ।। ५.५८.१२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahatāpi mahābāhuḥ pratyayena mahābalaḥ ।preṣito rāvaṇenaiva saha vīrairmadotkaṭaiḥ ।। 5.58.127 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thinking that Indrajit will surely kill me, the strongarmed mighty Ravana again sent intoxicated demon warriors.

verses.sloka: सो ऽविषह्यं हि मां बुद्ध्वा स्वबलं चावमर्दितम् ।ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण स तु मां प्राबध्नाच्चातिवेगितः ।। ५.५८.१२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'viṣahyaṁ hi māṁ buddhvā svabalaṁ cāvamarditam ।brāhmeṇāstreṇa sa tu māṁ prābadhnāccātivegitaḥ ।। 5.58.128 ।।।।

translations.english: "Realising that I cannot be slain and that his (Indrajit's) power is reduced, he released Brahma's weapon on me with high speed and captured me.

verses.sloka: रज्जुभिश्चाभिबध्नन्ति ततो मां तत्र राक्षसाः ।रावणस्य समीपं च गृहीत्वा मामुपानयन् ।। ५.५८.१२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rajjubhiścābhibadhnanti tato māṁ tatra rākṣasāḥ ।rāvaṇasya samīpaṁ ca gṛhītvā māmupānayan ।। 5.58.129 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the demons bound me with ropes and brought me to Ravana.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा सम्भाषितश्चाहं रावणेन दुरात्मना ।पृष्टश्च लङ्कागमनं राक्षसानां च तं वधम् ।। ५.५८.१३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣitaścāhaṁ rāvaṇena durātmanā ।pṛṣṭaśca laṅkāgamanaṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca taṁ vadham ।। 5.58.130 ।।।।

translations.english: "The wickedminded Ravana, then enquired me why I came to Lanka and why I killed the demons.

verses.sloka: तत्सर्वं च मया तत्र सीतार्थमिति जल्पितम् ।। ५.५८.१३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaṁ ca mayā tatra sītārthamiti jalpitam ।। 5.58.131 ।।।।

translations.english: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

verses.sloka: अस्याहं दर्शनाकांक्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो ।मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम् ।। ५.५८.१३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: asyāhaṁ darśanākāṁkṣī prāptastvadbhavanaṁ vibho ।mārutasyaurasaḥ putro vānaro hanumānaham ।। 5.58.132 ।।।।

translations.english: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

verses.sloka: रामदूतं च मां विद्धि सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम् ।सो ऽहं दूत्येन रामस्य त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः ।। ५.५८.१३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmadūtaṁ ca māṁ viddhi sugrīvasacivaṁ kapim ।so 'haṁ dūtyena rāmasya tvatsakāśamihāgataḥ ।। 5.58.133 ।।।।

translations.english: 'I am a vanara, a messenger of Rama and minister of Sugriva.You may know that I have come here to convey the message of Rama to you.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवश्च महातेजाः स त्वां कुशलमब्रवीत् ।धर्मार्थकामसहितं हितं पथ्यमुवाच च ।। ५.५८.१३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvaśca mahātejāḥ sa tvāṁ kuśalamabravīt ।dharmārthakāmasahitaṁ hitaṁ pathyamuvāca ca ।। 5.58.134 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Highly powerful Sugriva enquires your welfare. He sends beneficial advice to you for your righteousness, pleasures and wellbeing.

verses.sloka: वसतो ऋश्यमूके मे पर्वते विपुलद्रुमे ।राघवो रणविक्रान्तो मित्रत्वं समुपागतः ।। ५.५८.१३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vasato ṛśyamūke me parvate vipuladrume ।rāghavo raṇavikrānto mitratvaṁ samupāgataḥ ।। 5.58.135 ।।।।

translations.english: 'While I was dwelling at the woodedmountain in Rshyamuka, a treaty of friendship was made with Rama, who is skilled in war.

verses.sloka: तेन मे कथितं राज्ञा भार्या मे रक्षसा हृता ।तत्र साहाय्यमस्माकं कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्वया ।। ५.५८.१३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena me kathitaṁ rājñā bhāryā me rakṣasā hṛtā ।tatra sāhāyyamasmākaṁ kāryaṁ sarvātmanā tvayā ।। 5.58.136 ।।।।

translations.english: 'The king said, ' My wife was abducted by a demon. I request your help by all means to get her'.

verses.sloka: मया च कथितं तस्मै वालिनश्च वधं प्रति ।तत्र साहाय्यहेतोर्मे समयं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ५.५८.१३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mayā ca kathitaṁ tasmai vālinaśca vadhaṁ prati ।tatra sāhāyyahetorme samayaṁ kartumarhasi ।। 5.58.137 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Sugriva told the story of Vali in turn and asked for his help and to make agreement to kill Vali.

verses.sloka: वालिना हृतराज्येन सुग्रीवेण महाप्रभुः ।चक्रे ऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः ।। ५.५८.१३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vālinā hṛtarājyena sugrīveṇa mahāprabhuḥ ।cakre 'gnisākṣikaṁ sakhyaṁ rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.58.138 ।।।।

translations.english: With fire as witness the great lord, Rama along with Lakshmana made friendship with Sugriva whose kingdom had been usurped.

verses.sloka: तेन वालिनमुत्पाट्य शरेणैकेन संयुगे ।वानराणां महाराजः कृतः स प्लवता प्रभुः ।। ५.५८.१३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena vālinamutpāṭya śareṇaikena saṁyuge ।vānarāṇāṁ mahārājaḥ kṛtaḥ sa plavatā prabhuḥ ।। 5.58.139 ।।।।

translations.english: 'In the combat Rama killed Vali with a single arrow and made Sugriva the king of vanaras.

verses.sloka: तस्य साहाय्यमस्माभिः कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्विह ।तेन प्रस्थापितस्तुभ्यं समीपमिह धर्मतः ।क्षिप्रमानीयतां सीता दीयतां राघवाय च ।। ५.५८.१४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya sāhāyyamasmābhiḥ kāryaṁ sarvātmanā tviha ।tena prasthāpitastubhyaṁ samīpamiha dharmataḥ ।kṣipramānīyatāṁ sītā dīyatāṁ rāghavāya ca ।। 5.58.140 ।।।।

translations.english: 'We too have to help him in this task. So a message is sent to you on righteous grounds.

verses.sloka: यावन्न हरयो वीरा विधमन्ति बलं तव ।। ५.५८.१४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: yāvanna harayo vīrā vidhamanti balaṁ tava ।। 5.58.141 ।।

translations.english: 'Before the heroic vanaras exterminate your entire army, return Sita at once to Rama.

verses.sloka: तेन प्रस्थापितस्तुभ्यं समीपमिह धर्मतः ।वानराणां प्रभावो हि न केन विदितः पुरा ।देवतानां सकाशं च ये गच्छन्ति निमन्त्रिताः ।। ५.५८.१४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena prasthāpitastubhyaṁ samīpamiha dharmataḥ ।vānarāṇāṁ prabhāvo hi na kena viditaḥ purā ।devatānāṁ sakāśaṁ ca ye gacchanti nimantritāḥ ।। 5.58.142 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Who knows not the power of Vanaras in the past? Even gods had sought their help.

verses.sloka: इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया ।मामैक्षत ततः क्रुद्धश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव ।। ५.५८.१४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: iti vānararājastvāmāhetyabhihito mayā ।māmaikṣata tataḥ kruddhaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva ।। 5.58.143 ।।।।

translations.english: 'This I was asked to tell you by the king of vanaras wishing your welfare'. 'Ravana then angrily looked at me as if to burn me.

verses.sloka: तेन वध्यो ऽहमाज्ञप्तो रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा ।मत्प्रभावमविज्ञाय रावणेन दुरात्मना ।। ५.५८.१४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena vadhyo 'hamājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā ।matprabhāvamavijñāya rāvaṇena durātmanā ।। 5.58.144 ।।।।

translations.english: "The evilminded demon, Ravana, who perpetrates dreadful acts ordered my slaughter, not knowing my power.

verses.sloka: ततो विभीषणो नाम तस्य भ्राता महामतिः ।तेन राक्षसराजो ऽसौ याचितो मम कारणात् ।। ५.५८.१४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato vibhīṣaṇo nāma tasya bhrātā mahāmatiḥ ।tena rākṣasarājo 'sau yācito mama kāraṇāt ।। 5.58.145 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibhisana, a very pious brother of the demon king, interceded on my behalf.

verses.sloka: नैवं राक्षसशार्दूल त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः ।राजशास्त्रव्यपेतो हि मार्गः संसेव्यते त्वया ।। ५.५८.१४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: naivaṁ rākṣasaśārdūla tyajyatāmeṣa niścayaḥ ।rājaśāstravyapeto hi mārgaḥ saṁsevyate tvayā ।। 5.58.146 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibhishana, a tiger among demons, asked Ravana to give up his decision as it was a forbidden course according to the science of royal polity.

verses.sloka: दूतवध्या न दृष्टा हि राजशास्त्रेषु राक्षस ।दूतेन वेदितव्यं च यथार्थं हितवादिना ।। ५.५८.१४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dūtavadhyā na dṛṣṭā hi rājaśāstreṣu rākṣasa ।dūtena veditavyaṁ ca yathārthaṁ hitavādinā ।। 5.58.147 ।।।।

translations.english: 'The royal code prohibits the murder of an emissary. A wellwishing emissary should convey the truth.

verses.sloka: सुमहत्यपराधे ऽपि दूतस्यातुलविक्रम ।विरूपकरणं दृष्टं न वधो ऽस्तीति शास्त्रतः ।। ५.५८.१४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sumahatyaparādhe 'pi dūtasyātulavikrama ।virūpakaraṇaṁ dṛṣṭaṁ na vadho 'stīti śāstrataḥ ।। 5.58.148 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O Ravana of immeasurable courage even if the emissary has done any kind of harm he may be mutilated but not murdered. Nowhere do the sastras allow killing (of an ambassador).

verses.sloka: विभीषणेनैवमुक्तो रावणः संदिदेश तान् ।राक्षसानेतदेवास्य लाङ्गूलं दह्यतामिति ।। ५.५८.१४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇenaivamukto rāvaṇaḥ saṁdideśa tān ।rākṣasānetadevāsya lāṅgūlaṁ dahyatāmiti ।। 5.58.149 ।।।।

translations.english: 'On hearing Vibhishana, Ravana instructed the demons to burn my tail.

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पुच्छं समन्ततः ।वेष्टितं शणवल्कैश्च जीर्णैः कार्पासजैः पटैः ।। ५.५८.१५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā pucchaṁ samantataḥ ।veṣṭitaṁ śaṇavalkaiśca jīrṇaiḥ kārpāsajaiḥ paṭaiḥ ।। 5.58.150 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard the king's words, all the demons collected and held my tail, wrapped it with saris of fibres and tattered rags of cotton.

verses.sloka: राक्षसाः सिद्धसन्नाहास्ततस्ते चण्डविक्रमाः ।तदा ऽदह्यन्त मे पुच्छं निघ्नन्तः काष्ठमुष्टिभिः ।बद्धस्य बहुभिः पाशैर्यन्त्रितस्य च राक्षसैः ।। ५.५८.१५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāḥ siddhasannāhāstataste caṇḍavikramāḥ ।tadā 'dahyanta me pucchaṁ nighnantaḥ kāṣṭhamuṣṭibhiḥ ।baddhasya bahubhiḥ pāśairyantritasya ca rākṣasaiḥ ।। 5.58.151 ।।।।

translations.english: "Many ferociously courageous demons got ready. They bound me and hit me with firesticks and fists. They fastened my tail with ropes and set in on fire.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते राक्षसाः शूरा बद्धं मामग्निसंवृतम् ।अघोषयन् राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः ।। ५.५८.१५२ ।।ः ।ततो ऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः ।। ५.५८.१५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataste rākṣasāḥ śūrā baddhaṁ māmagnisaṁvṛtam ।aghoṣayan rājamārge nagaradvāramāgatāḥ ।। 5.58.152 ।।ḥ ।tato 'haṁ sumahadrūpaṁ saṁkṣipya punarātmanaḥ ।। 5.58.153 ।।

translations.english: "The brave demons took me round the city through the royal streets and announced loudly to let every one know that I am bound and that my tail has been set on fire.

verses.sloka: राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः ।। ५.५८.१५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: rājamārge nagaradvāramāgatāḥ ।। 5.58.152 ।।

translations.english: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).

verses.sloka: ः ।विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः ।आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम् ।ततस्तन्नगरद्वारं वेगेनाप्लुतवानहम् ।। ५.५८.१५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ḥ ।vimocayitvā taṁ bandhaṁ prakṛtisthaḥ sthitaḥ punaḥ ।āyasaṁ parighaṁ gṛhya tāni rakṣāṁsyasūdayam ।tatastannagaradvāraṁ vegenāplutavānaham ।। 5.58.154 ।।।।

translations.english: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).

verses.sloka: पुच्छेन च प्रदीप्तेन तां पुरीं साट्टगोपुराम् ।दहाम्यहमसम्भ्रान्तो युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रजाः ।। ५.५८.१५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pucchena ca pradīptena tāṁ purīṁ sāṭṭagopurām ।dahāmyahamasambhrānto yugāntāgniriva prajāḥ ।। 5.58.155 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then I leaped to the entrance gate of the city without being perplexed. With my burning tail I set fire to the boundaries and towering mansions which looked like the world at the end of dissolution.

verses.sloka: विनष्टा जानकी व्यक्तं न ह्यदग्धः प्रदृश्यते ।लङ्कायां कश्चिदुद्देशः सर्वा भस्मीकृता पुरी ।। ५.५८.१५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vinaṣṭā jānakī vyaktaṁ na hyadagdhaḥ pradṛśyate ।laṅkāyāṁ kaściduddeśaḥ sarvā bhasmīkṛtā purī ।। 5.58.156 ।।।।

translations.english: Surely Janaki has perished, I feared, for not a spot in Lanka is seen unburnt and the whole city has been reduced to ashes.

verses.sloka: दहता च मया लङ्कां दग्धा सीता न संशयः ।रामस्य हि महत् कार्यं मयेदं वितथीकृतम् ।। ५.५८.१५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dahatā ca mayā laṅkāṁ dagdhā sītā na saṁśayaḥ ।rāmasya hi mahat kāryaṁ mayedaṁ vitathīkṛtam ।। 5.58.157 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lanka has been burnt by me and Sita might have also been burnt. There is no doubt. The great purpose of Rama has been spoilt by me'.

verses.sloka: इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः ।। ५.५८.१५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: iti śokasamāviṣṭaścintāmahamupāgataḥ ।। 5.58.158 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.

verses.sloka: अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम् ।जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिताम् ।। ५.५८.१५९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athāhaṁ vācamaśrauṣaṁ cāraṇānāṁ śubhākṣarām ।jānakī na ca dagdheti vismayodantabhāṣitām ।। 5.58.159 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.

verses.sloka: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम् ।अदग्द्धा जानकीत्येवं निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षिता ।। ५.५८.१६० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato me buddhirutpannā śrutvā tāmadbhutāṁ giram ।adagddhā jānakītyevaṁ nimittaiścopalakṣitā ।। 5.58.160 ।।।।

translations.english: "It was amazing to hear the words of the charanas. On hearing that Jankai had not been burnt, I understood that it is on her account (that he is also not burnt although his tail was ignited.)

verses.sloka: दीप्यमाने तु लाङ्गूले न मां दहति पावकः ।हृदयं च प्रहृष्टं मे वाताः सुरभिगन्धिनः ।। ५.५८.१६१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dīpyamāne tu lāṅgūle na māṁ dahati pāvakaḥ ।hṛdayaṁ ca prahṛṣṭaṁ me vātāḥ surabhigandhinaḥ ।। 5.58.161 ।।।।

translations.english: "My tail was burning but I was not burnt by fire. There was joy in my heart. The wind carried sweet fragrance.

verses.sloka: तैर्निमित्तैश्च दृष्टार्थैः कारणैश्च महागुणैः ।ऋषिवाक्यैश्च सिद्धार्थैरभवं हृष्टमानसः ।। ५.५८.१६२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tairnimittaiśca dṛṣṭārthaiḥ kāraṇaiśca mahāguṇaiḥ ।ṛṣivākyaiśca siddhārthairabhavaṁ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 5.58.162 ।।।।

translations.english: "For these two auspicious signs and the highly propitious words uttered by the sages I felt glad at heart.

verses.sloka: पुनर्दृष्ट्वा च वैदेहीं विसृष्टश्च तया पुनः ।। ५.५८.१६३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: punardṛṣṭvā ca vaidehīṁ visṛṣṭaśca tayā punaḥ ।। 5.58.163 ।।।।

translations.english: After seeing Vaidehi once more and being dismissed by her again, I reached Mount Arishta and, longing to see you all, leapt up to return.

verses.sloka: ततः पर्वतमासाद्य तत्रारिष्टमहं पुनः ।प्रतिप्लवनमारेभे युष्मद्दर्शनकाङ्क्षया ।। ५.५८.१६४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ parvatamāsādya tatrāriṣṭamahaṁ punaḥ ।pratiplavanamārebhe yuṣmaddarśanakāṅkṣayā ।। 5.58.164 ।।।।

translations.english: "Passing along the path of the Windgod, the Moon, the Sun, the siddhas and the gandharvas I came to see you.

verses.sloka: ततः पवनचन्द्रार्कसिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम् ।पन्थानमहमाक्रम्य भवतो दृष्टवानिह ।। ५.५८.१६५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pavanacandrārkasiddhagandharvasevitam ।panthānamahamākramya bhavato dṛṣṭavāniha ।। 5.58.165 ।।।।

translations.english: "Everything was favourable to me by the power of Rama, by your goodwill and for the great purpose of Sugriva.

verses.sloka: राघवस्य प्रभावेन भवतां चैव तेजसा ।सुग्रीवस्य च कार्यार्थं मया सर्वमनुष्टितम् ।। ५.५८.१६६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya prabhāvena bhavatāṁ caiva tejasā ।sugrīvasya ca kāryārthaṁ mayā sarvamanuṣṭitam ।। 5.58.166 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let all that could not be done there and still remains to be done, be accomplished by you. I have presented the entire thing". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: एतत्सर्वं मया तत्र यथावदुपपादितम् ।अत्र यन्न कृतं शेषं तत्सर्वं क्रियतामिति ।। ५.५८.१६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṁ mayā tatra yathāvadupapāditam ।atra yanna kṛtaṁ śeṣaṁ tatsarvaṁ kriyatāmiti ।। 5.58.167 ।।
